column2: Thin pale balsa strips form a lightweight model airplane wing, with loose soft-grained blocks and a craft knife nearby.
A small brass band performs on a raised outdoor bandstand, sheltered by a round roof above the public lawn.
Three rigid bangles overlap on a wrist, showing their continuous circular bands without clasps or dangling charms.
A raised earthen firing step runs inside a historical defensive parapet, allowing a standing guard to see above the wall.
A reckless rider attempts to leap a wide ditch on a tiny bicycle, ignoring the visibly inadequate takeoff ramp.
An angry raider smashes an innocent household's cooking pots, while frightened residents retreat behind the doorway without injury.
A rider sits bareback on a calm horse, with no saddle between their legs and the animal's back.
A fairground barker calls visitors toward a show tent, waving an open hand beside a small ticket booth.
A barnyard surrounds a red wooden barn, with chickens, a water trough and a wheelbarrow on the packed earth.
An aneroid barometer's needle responds to air pressure, with its round dial and flexible sealed capsule shown in a simple cutaway.
A barracuda swims in profile, with a long silver body, pointed head and projecting lower jaw bearing sharp teeth.
A guitarist makes a barre chord, pressing several strings simultaneously with one straight index finger across the fretboard.
A barren field contains cracked earth and scattered stones, with no crops growing beside an abandoned irrigation channel.
A child is accused of breaking a window that remains fully intact, looking bewildered beneath an adult's pointing finger.
A baseball baseman waits with a glove beside the base, one foot close to the bag as a runner approaches.
A judge hears a case inside a large historical court hall, with rows of columns and citizens gathered before the bench.
A bowl of cooked basmati rice shows long separate slender grains, beside a small heap of uncooked rice.
A bassinet holds a sleeping baby in a small oval basket, supported by a low stand with a protective hood.
A boxer strikes a padded training bag forcefully, with the bag denting beneath the glove and swinging away.
An artisan applies wax to fabric before dyeing it, with a completed batik cloth displaying the resisted pattern nearby.
A bat's leathery wings are shown spread around its furry body, emphasizing its elongated finger bones and thin membranes.
A cheap glittering trinket has bright imitation gems and flaking metallic paint, resting in a tiny open gift box.
A bauxite specimen has a rough reddish-brown surface with small rounded earthy nodules, shown beside its freshly broken interior.
A child bawls loudly after dropping an ice cream, mouth wide open and tears streaming beside the fallen cone.
A slow bayou winds through low swamp woodland, with cypress knees and calm dark water beneath hanging moss.
A toy bear has two small shiny bead-like black eyes, shown close up against its soft brown fabric face.
A knitted beanie has a close-fitting rounded crown and folded ribbed cuff, resting beside a pair of winter gloves.
Neighbors beautify a neglected courtyard by planting flowers, painting a bench and arranging clean pots along the wall.
A patterned bedspread lies smoothly across a made bed, extending over the sides above neatly aligned pillows.
A hearty beef stew contains visible browned beef chunks, with a raw beef cut and vegetables beside the pot.
A sturdy pair of gardening boots fits its muddy outdoor task, worn by a gardener working safely among thorny plants.
A potted begonia displays asymmetrical leaves and clusters of delicate pink flowers, with one leaf's unequal halves clearly visible.
A diner belches after a large meal, covering their mouth with one hand while leaning back from the empty plate.
A flexible metal strip bends smoothly between two hands without breaking, its straight unused counterpart resting below.
A curved bending jig holds a thin wooden strip against a shaped form, secured by evenly spaced clamps.
A bespectacled adult reads a book, with round glasses resting clearly on the bridge of their nose.
An animal's rough shaggy hide, clawed paw and bared canine teeth are emphasized in one complete prowling wolf.
A cruel overseer laughs while destroying a worker's carefully made basket, with the worker recoiling in distress; no injury.
A betel vine climbs a wooden support, displaying glossy heart-shaped green leaves and slender trailing stems.
A bevy of quail huddles beneath a low bush, with several rounded birds gathered closely around their chicks.
Two siblings bicker over a single toy, tugging opposite ends while frowning and pointing at each other.
A bicyclist pedals along a quiet road, hands on the handlebars and feet on the pedals, wearing a fitted helmet.
Bifocal glasses rest on a table, their lenses showing distinct lower reading segments beneath the main viewing areas.
An enormous pumpkin sits beside an ordinary small pumpkin, with a gardener struggling to wrap both arms around it.
A stubborn speaker covers their ears while rejecting several clearly presented counterexamples, refusing to look at the evidence board.
A still billabong lies beside a curving river channel, separated by a narrow strip of land and ringed with reeds.
An open leather billfold reveals folded banknotes in a long compartment, with a simple crease dividing its two halves.
A person practices calm breathing while watching their own pulse trace on a monitor, with a finger sensor attached.

A lamb bleats toward its mother, mouth open and small head lifted beside the ewe's woolly flank.

A blithe child skips through a garden, smiling freely while swinging a small basket beside flowering shrubs.
Dough bloats upward inside a mixing bowl, bulging well above the rim beneath a loose cloth cover.
A sturdy blocky chair has thick square legs, a broad solid seat and heavy rectangular arm supports.
Two opposing leaders transfer a civic key peacefully, with soldiers lowering their weapons and no injuries or blood.
A bloodthirsty fantasy wolf snarls eagerly toward fleeing prey, teeth exposed and claws extended, without wounds or blood.

A glassblower blows through a long tube into a glowing molten-glass bubble, supporting the tube above a workbench.
A whale cutaway shows a thick pale blubber layer beneath the skin, with the full animal's outline remaining recognizable.
A factory maintenance worker in practical blue work clothes repairs a machine, with a tool belt and gloves clearly visible.
A clump of meadow bluegrass shows narrow leaf blades and loose branching flower panicles above its tufted base.
A blustery wind bends a roadside tree and turns an umbrella inside out, while loose leaves swirl around it.
A boater rows a small wooden boat across calm water, gripping both oars from the central seat.
A wooden bobbin is tightly wound with blue sewing thread, with one loose thread end trailing across the table.
Several large bocce balls rest on a sandy court around one much smaller target ball, with a player's hand releasing another.
A complete ordinary human body stands in a neutral pose, with head, torso, arms and legs all clearly visible.
A bodybuilder performs a controlled dumbbell curl, displaying developed arm muscles beside a gym bench and weights.
A bola has three weighted leather balls joined by cords at one central knot, laid out fully on the ground.
An open cotton boll reveals fluffy white cotton emerging between dry pointed brown segments, still attached to its stem.
A historical aircraft bombardier occupies the glazed nose station, looking through a bombsight while the aircraft remains parked.
A historical aerial bomb rests inertly on a museum support, showing its rounded nose and rear stabilizing fins only.

A child bonks their forehead gently against a low cupboard door, recoiling with surprise beside the open cabinet.
A beautiful garden rose opens in a balanced spiral of soft petals, with one fresh leaf and a dew drop.
Two dancers perform lively boogie-woogie steps beside a pianist, bending their knees and moving their feet energetically.
A publisher checks freshly printed books beside stacked manuscripts, handing a finished copy to an author in the workshop.
A clandestine distiller hides unbranded liquor bottles inside plain crates in a concealed cellar, without showing production equipment or instructions.
A compass-oriented globe emphasizes the northern region above a forested landscape, with snowy land extending toward its upper pole.
A woman's private sitting room contains a dressing table, mirror, soft armchair and folded garments beside a screen.
Clear golden bouillon fills a simple bowl, with a ladle lifting the transparent broth above a nearby stockpot.
A rubber ball bounces upward from the floor, with a compressed contact shadow and curved motion marks beneath it.
A bouncy child springs energetically beside a playground bench, smiling with both feet momentarily off the ground.
A cinema ticket seller serves customers through a box-office window, handing a blank ticket across the counter.
An enclosed railway boxcar stands on rails, with a sliding side door partly open to reveal stacked cargo.
A boxy small car has a nearly rectangular body, upright windows and flat roof, shown clearly in three-quarter view.
An ordinary adult man stands casually beside a park bench, with simple clothes and a relaxed neutral pose.
A foolish adult tries to carry water in a perforated colander, looking surprised as it pours out below.
A clever child solves a complex wooden construction puzzle, fitting the final piece while others study the finished structure.
A cook braises a joint of meat in a lidded casserole, lifting the lid to reveal a shallow layer of simmering liquid.
A beer hall contains long communal tables, sturdy mugs and servers carrying trays between seated adult customers.
Several bratwurst sausages brown on a grill, showing plump pale casings and gentle curved shapes without branding.
A flexed upper arm shows a rounded biceps muscle beneath ordinary skin, with the forearm bent toward the shoulder.
A brawny worker easily carries a heavy timber beam, with broad shoulders and strongly developed arms clearly engaged.
A mortar and pestle grind coarse seeds into fine powder, with crushed fragments gathered beneath the pestle.
A delicate glass goblet has a thin stem and fragile bowl, with a small chipped rim and shards beside it.
A smaller iceberg breaks away from a larger ice shelf, leaving a clear widening gap filled with seawater.
A cyclist descends at breakneck speed toward a sharp turn, leaning dangerously while loose stones scatter beneath the wheels.
A stone breakwater curves outward from a harbor, blocking rough sea waves while boats rest in calm water behind it.
A simplified rib cage highlights the long central breastbone, with ribs attaching on both sides and the rest subdued.
An improvised birdhouse combines spare wood, a discarded tin roof and mismatched hinges into one workable handmade structure.
A bright yellow sulfur specimen rests on dark rock, showing its brittle irregular crystal faces without smoke or flames.
A briny pool leaves white salt crystals around its drying edge, beside a shallow tide channel meeting the sea.
A brisket cut rests on a butcher's board, showing a broad flat breast-meat slab with a fat layer above.
A full-size broadsheet newspaper is spread widely across a reading table, with large page columns and picture blocks but no readable text.
A sailing ship is shown directly from the side, emphasizing the broad hull flank and rows of closed gunports.
Two adults quarrel face to face over a damaged fence, gesturing angrily while remaining physically separated.
A cook broils fish beneath a direct overhead heating element, with its top surface browning above a shallow drip tray.
An abandoned industrial site contains disused factory sheds, rusty pipework and weeds growing through the empty loading yard.
A brown sandstone block exposes visible sand grains and warm reddish-brown layers, with a chipped edge and loose grit.
A gossip spreads a rumor from one neighbor to another, whispering behind a hand while the listener leans closer.
An adult with dark brown hair adjusts a loose curl before a mirror, showing the hair color clearly in natural light.
A brutish intruder tears food apart with bare hands and snarls at guests, upsetting the formerly orderly table.
A soft buckskin leather piece folds easily over a craftsman's hand, with its suede-like inner surface and natural uneven edge visible.
A clown performs deliberate buffoonery by wearing oversized shoes on their hands, making a nearby child laugh.
A bulbous plant base swells into a rounded underground bulb, with a short stem and fine roots emerging below.
A bullfighter sidesteps a charging bull in an arena, holding a bright cape with no wounds, spears or blood.
A bulldozer levels a mound of earth, pushing loose soil forward with its broad blade across a construction plot.
A powerful athlete lowers their head and squares their shoulders in a bull-like charging stance before a padded training sled.
A large bumblebee has a round densely hairy black-and-yellow body, small folded wings and pollen baskets on its hind legs.
A bumbling waiter tangles a tray in a curtain and spills empty cups, looking flustered beside the awkward mess.
A child discovers a punctured bicycle tire just before an outing, shoulders drooping beside the ready helmet and backpack.
An earthen bund holds irrigation water around a rice field, with a narrow raised path following its top.
A burdock plant shows broad leaves above a long brown taproot, with hooked burr heads attached to its branching stem.
A small city clusters streets, shops and apartment buildings around a central square, enclosed within one compact town view.
A piece of coarse burlap has a loose visible jute weave, with a frayed edge beside a filled sack.
A baby burps gently over a caregiver's shoulder, with the caregiver patting its back above a folded cloth.
A burrito has a soft tortilla wrapped around beans, rice and vegetables, with one cut end showing the packed filling.
A small donkey stands beside a cart, with long upright ears, a short mane and a tufted tail.

A knight sits upright on a calm horse, wearing armor and carrying a sheathed sword beside a simple shield.

A cabriolet car stands with its fabric roof folded back, exposing both seats above the closed side doors.

A hen cackles loudly beside a nest containing a newly laid egg, beak open and neck stretched forward.
A human cadaver lies respectfully beneath a plain sheet on a mortuary table, with the face covered and no wounds.
A small lidded tea caddy holds loose tea leaves, with its scoop resting beside the open container.

A caliper's two jaws measure the outside diameter of a metal cylinder, with the sliding carriage and depth rod visible.
A white calla lily has one curved trumpet-like spathe surrounding a yellow spadix, above broad arrow-shaped green leaves.
An inexperienced young apprentice awkwardly holds a hammer, watching the patient expert demonstrate the correct grip nearby.
A worker's palm shows a thickened callus at a repeated pressure point, with ordinary surrounding skin and no wound.
A cow stands beside her just-born calf on clean straw, gently licking it while the calf attempts to stand.
A camellia shrub bears glossy serrated leaves and a layered pink flower, with several round buds on nearby stems.
